_comment: Merila's welcome. Plays once: her ForceGreet the first time a member is in the hall with her. Each list is the spoken parts in order; a long approved line is split at its sentences into vanilla's 150-character responses, word for word. choices: the player's prompts.
welcome: Allow me to formally welcome you to the guild hall, adventurer. I'm Merila.
I assist Willem, the Guild Master, and I keep this hall's records and its library.
This is the Guild's only hall in Skyrim. Members eat in the tavern, sleep upstairs, train below, and bring their work to the counter.
As a member of the guild, this hall is open to you. Now, any questions?
up: The Guild Master's office and my library are on the second floor... along with the staff rooms; please leave those to us.
The stairs go further up to the attic, where members sleep.
The bunk inside the door, by the window, is yours, and what you leave in its chest stays there.
You may also notice a locked door at the top of the stairs; that is not open to adventurers so stay out.
down: Marius, a retired A-rank who lives here, trains members in arms and armor so you should introduce yourself when you get the chance.
The targets and dummies are free to use.
There's a bath beside it, and you'll want it after training or coming back from a long job.
There's also a cellar under the kitchen, and a small prison cell which we haven't had to use in years.
